messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Randomized search with simulated annealing and local coordinate perturbations seeded from known best solutions

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Simulated annealing with adaptive kernel perturbations (Gaussian steps scaled by current temperature and per-point distance to nearest neighbor), seeded from the known optimal 6-point pentagon-plus-center configuration and greedily extended to 13 points, will converge to a configuration with minimum triangle area exceeding 0.0025. The optimal arrangement will exhibit approximate 3-fold or 5-fold symmetry rather than strict grid structure, because lattice-like configurations force collinear triples yielding zero-area triangles, while perturbed symmetric clusters distribute the minimum-area constraint more evenly across all 286 triples."}
